answer: A verifiable delay function protocol deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to compute sequential, non-parallelizable proofs. An adversary incurs the scarce resource cost of dedicated CPU cores and sustained electrical power per active persona. Whether an agent coordinates freight at an export wharf, monitors a walnut grove, or tracks cedar inventory, its identity requires non-stop computation. However, specialized ASIC hardware accelerates processing, creating structural centralization.
